meta.title: Notes Board
meta.description: Two things in one plugin: a Notes Board sidebar panel that renders each workspace's .agents/notes decision records (architecture baseline, evolution timeline, pitfalls, decision list, plus the five-section detail drawer), and five native tools (note_search / note_read / note_write / note_verify / note_skip) with an end-of-turn hook that forces every turn touching code to either write a note or explicitly skip. Ships an MCP server too (bin/agent-notes-mcp).
